title: Beyond Medical Certificate: Functional Disability And Occupational Justice In Motor Accident Compensation
description: In a recent judgement, the Supreme Court enhanced the compensation that was awarded to M. Paramesh, a mason from Tamil Nadu who lost his right leg above the knee because of a road accident, from ₹23.86 lakh to ₹40.29 lakh.[1] Before the matter reached the Supreme Court, the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal had awarded him ₹10.84 lakh while the Madras High Court increased it to ₹23.86 lakh after revising his monthly income and adding future prospects.
